EdgeHound Performance Review — 2026-06-17

Portfolio is modestly profitable at +1.13% on $10K starting equity, with 66 closed trades and $45.13 realized P&L. The headline number understates signal-level divergence. SHORT_FAVORITE is the clear engine of value: 22 trades, 14 wins (63.6%), +$1,230 PnL — predominantly MLB and combat sports, with the hypothesis tracker confirming 68% win rate on high-price sports markets (CI 51-86%). This engine is the fund. MOMENTUM remains disabled from last cycle, correctly so: 21 trades, 8 wins (38%), -$1,019 — deeply negative and no hypothesis has turned constructive. VOLUME_SPIKE is marginally positive (+$258) but the pattern is noisy: wins come from large single-event bounces (Iran +$479) while losses are a string of -25% stop-outs on low-conviction event markets and baseball long-side bets. The recent wave of soccer World Cup volume-spike entries showed near-zero drift at expiry, suggesting the edge there is thin. ELITE_FOLLOW has only 4 trades — too small to evaluate. SMART_CONSENSUS disabled, one trade, -$385 — keep off.

Key risk: maxEventExposure at $500 with SHORT_FAVORITE staking 400-500 per MLB game creates healthy concentration but is capped appropriately. kellyMult at 0.10 is conservative given demonstrated edge; a modest lift to 0.15 is warranted for SHORT_FAVORITE to capitalize. Brier score 0.269 suggests moderate calibration — acceptable but not tight.

Recommendation: Raise kellyMult to 0.15 to harvest SHORT_FAVORITE edge more fully. Raise maxEventExposure to 750 to allow slightly larger single-game positions. No other changes. Continue monitoring VOLUME_SPIKE for structural edge decay.

changeReasoning: kellyMult raised from 0.10 to 0.15: SHORT_FAVORITE has 22 trades with statistically meaningful positive edge (63.6% win rate, +$1,230); the floor setting is unnecessarily suppressing position sizing on the fund's best signal. A 50% increase in Kelly fraction remains conservative at 0.15. maxEventExposure raised from 500 to 750: current $500 cap is occasionally binding on SHORT_FAVORITE's highest-conviction sports entries; modest increase allows fuller expression without undue concentration risk on a single event. All other parameters held: pMin 0.57 appropriate, maxExposure 0.4 appropriate given modest equity base, MOMENTUM/SMART_CONSENSUS remain disabled pending evidence of positive expectancy.
